PyMC, NumPyro, Stan — the productive rec.src:
PyMC, NumPyro, Stan — the productive recipe for Bayesian
          modelling. Declare the model, pick an inference engine,
          inspect diagnostics. Two live demos in the browser plus
          the checklist of what to look at after every run.

What a PPL is — and isn't.zh: 概率编程语言（PPL）是什么 —— 以及不是什么
What a PPL is — and isn't.src: What a PPL is — and isn't

A probabilistic programming language let.zh: 概率编程语言让你以代码的形式编写生成模型。你声明先验、采样分布、观测；运行时负责后验推断。同一个模型只需改动一行开关，就可以用 HMC、NUTS、ADVI、SMC 或拉普拉斯近似来运行。
A probabilistic programming language let.src:
A probabilistic programming language lets you write a
          generative model as code. You declare priors, sampling
          distributions, observations; the runtime takes care of
          posterior inference. The same model can be run with HMC,
          NUTS, ADVI, SMC, or Laplace approximation depending on a
          one-line switch.

Best NUTS sampler; rock-solid for hierar.src: Best NUTS sampler; rock-solid for hierarchical models

Pythonic; large user base; rich tools (A.src: Pythonic; large user base; rich tools (ArviZ)

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n You w.zh:
@@T0@@一句口号。@@T1@@
          你只需写一次数学。PPL 负责推断。在 HMC 与 VI 之间切换只是改一个标志，而非重写代码。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n You w.src: The slogan. You write the math once. The PPL handles the inference. Switching between HMC and VI is a flag change, not a rewrite.

with model:\n theta = Beta(\"theta\",.zh:
with model:
    theta = Beta("theta", alpha=1, beta=1)        # prior
    y = Binomial("y", n=20, p=theta, observed=14) # likelihood + obs

    trace = sample(2000, chains=4)                 # NUTS
    az.plot_trace(trace)
    az.summary(trace)                              # r-hat, ESS
with model:\n theta = Beta(\"theta\",.src:
with model:
    theta = Beta("theta", alpha=1, beta=1)        # prior
    y = Binomial("y", n=20, p=theta, observed=14) # likelihood + obs

    trace = sample(2000, chains=4)                 # NUTS
    az.plot_trace(trace)
    az.summary(trace)                              # r-hat, ESS

Three things every PPL gives you:.zh: 每个 PPL 都为你提供三样东西：
Three things every PPL gives you:.src: Three things every PPL gives you:

@@T0@@Declarative model.@@T1@@ Variables.zh: @@T0@@声明式模型。@@T1@@ 变量有名称，分布有先验，观测与数据相绑定。
@@T0@@Declarative model.@@T1@@ Variables.src: Declarative model. Variables are named, distributions have priors, observations attach to data.

@@T0@@Inference engine.@@T1@@ NUTS / HMC.zh: @@T0@@推断引擎。@@T1@@ 默认使用 NUTS / HMC；按需使用 VI / 拉普拉斯近似。
@@T0@@Inference engine.@@T1@@ NUTS / HMC.src: Inference engine. NUTS / HMC by default; VI / Laplace on demand.

@@T0@@Diagnostics.@@T1@@ r-hat (between-.zh: @@T0@@诊断信息。@@T1@@ r-hat（链间收敛性）、ESS（有效样本量）、发散转移、后验预测检验。
@@T0@@Diagnostics.@@T1@@ r-hat (between-.src: Diagnostics. r-hat (between-chain convergence), ESS (effective sample size), divergent transitions, posterior predictive checks.

Live: coin-bias model — HMC vs analytic.zh: 实时：硬币偏置模型 —— HMC 与解析解对比
Live: coin-bias model — HMC vs analytic.src: Live: coin-bias model — HMC vs analytic

The simplest Bayesian model: $\\theta \\.zh: 最简单的贝叶斯模型：$\theta \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1, 1)$，$y \sim \mathrm{Bernoulli}(\theta)$。Beta-二项共轭给出解析后验；一条 HMC 链应当与之吻合。用按钮添加数据，并实时运行 HMC。
The simplest Bayesian model: $\\theta \\.src:
The simplest Bayesian model: $\theta \sim \mathrm{Beta}(1, 1)$,
          $y \sim \mathrm{Bernoulli}(\theta)$. Beta-Binomial conjugacy
          gives the analytic posterior; an HMC chain should match it.
          Add data with the buttons and run HMC live.

@@T0@@k / n @@T1@@0/0@@T2@@@@T3@@\n.src: k / n 0/0 r-hat — ESS —

Posterior: HMC samples vs analytic Beta.zh: 后验：HMC 样本与解析 Beta 对比
Posterior: HMC samples vs analytic Beta.src: Posterior: HMC samples vs analytic Beta

Live: 2-D Bayesian regression — HMC vs V.zh: 实时：二维贝叶斯回归 —— HMC 与 VI 对比
Live: 2-D Bayesian regression — HMC vs V.src: Live: 2-D Bayesian regression — HMC vs VI

A Bayesian linear regression with a smal.zh: 一个小数据集上的贝叶斯线性回归。HMC 给出诚实的后验；均值场 VI 拟合一个因子化的高斯分布。观察可信带如何不同：VI 通常过窄，尤其是在参数存在相关性的方向上。
A Bayesian linear regression with a smal.src:
A Bayesian linear regression with a small dataset. HMC gives
          honest posterior; mean-field VI fits a factorised Gaussian.
          Watch the credible bands differ: VI is usually too narrow,
          especially in directions where the parameters correlate.

HMC posterior over (slope, intercept).zh: (斜率, 截距) 上的 HMC 后验

@@T0@@The VI trap.@@T1@@\n Mean.zh:
@@T0@@VI 的陷阱。@@T1@@
          均值场 VI 在参数之间做因子化分解，因此无法表示相关的后验。HMC 的等高线常常是倾斜的；而 VI 的等高线总是与坐标轴平行。若要获得高质量的可信区间，宜选用 HMC 或满秩 VI。
@@T0@@The VI trap.@@T1@@\n Mean.src: The VI trap. Mean-field VI factorises across parameters, so it can't represent correlated posteriors. The HMC contours often slant; the VI contours always align with the axes. For credible-interval-quality work, prefer HMC or full-rank VI.

@@T0@@r-hat &lt; 1.01.@@T1@@ Between-cha.zh: @@T0@@r-hat < 1.01。@@T1@@ 每个参数上的链间一致性。高于 1.05 = 链尚未收敛；请运行更久或重新参数化。
@@T0@@r-hat &lt; 1.01.@@T1@@ Between-cha.src: r-hat < 1.01. Between-chain consensus on each parameter. Above 1.05 = chains haven't converged; run longer or reparameterise.

@@T0@@ESS &gt; 400.@@T1@@ Effective samp.zh: @@T0@@ESS > 400。@@T1@@ 有效样本量。低于此值，你的后验摘要会有噪声。
@@T0@@ESS &gt; 400.@@T1@@ Effective samp.src: ESS > 400. Effective sample size. Below this, your posterior summary is noisy.

@@T0@@Divergent transitions.@@T1@@ NUTS-.zh: @@T0@@发散转移。@@T1@@ NUTS 特有的问题。哪怕只有 5 次发散（占链的 ≥ 0%）也意味着几何过于弯曲 —— 试试非中心化参数化，或增大 @@T2@@target_accept@@T3@@。
@@T0@@Divergent transitions.@@T1@@ NUTS-.src: Divergent transitions. NUTS-specific. Even 5 divergences ≥ 0% of the chain means the geometry is too curved — try a non-centred parameterisation or increase target_accept.

@@T0@@Posterior predictive checks.@@T1@@.zh: @@T0@@后验预测检验。@@T1@@ 从后验模拟新数据，并与观测数据比较。此处拟合不佳，其重要性远胜过任何单一诊断。
@@T0@@Posterior predictive checks.@@T1@@.src: Posterior predictive checks. Simulate new data from the posterior and compare to observed. Bad fit here ≫ any single diagnostic.

@@T0@@Prior predictive checks.@@T1@@ Sam.zh: @@T0@@先验预测检验。@@T1@@ 仅从先验采样。若这些样本看起来不合理，则你的先验是以一种糟糕的方式无信息的。
@@T0@@Prior predictive checks.@@T1@@ Sam.src: Prior predictive checks. Sample from the prior alone. If those samples look implausible, your prior is uninformative-in-a-bad-way.

@@T0@@LOO / WAIC.@@T1@@ Cross-validated.zh: @@T0@@LOO / WAIC。@@T1@@ 用于模型比较的交叉验证预测精度。ArviZ 两者都提供。
@@T0@@LOO / WAIC.@@T1@@ Cross-validated.src: LOO / WAIC. Cross-validated predictive accuracy for model comparison. ArviZ ships both.

What PPLs are for (and not for).zh: PPL 适合（以及不适合）做什么
What PPLs are for (and not for).src: What PPLs are for (and not for)

@@T0@@Good fits.@@T1@@ Hierarchical mode.zh: @@T0@@合适的场景。@@T1@@ 分层模型、少数据、校准良好的不确定性、参数解释、带机制性先验的科学模型。
@@T0@@Good fits.@@T1@@ Hierarchical mode.src: Good fits. Hierarchical models, small data, calibrated uncertainty, parameter interpretation, scientific models with mechanistic priors.

@@T0@@Reach for instead:@@T1@@ deep lear.zh: @@T0@@改用其他方案：@@T1@@ 数百万样本上的深度学习（梯度下降更快）、纯点估计（sklearn / XGBoost）、生产环境部署（PPL 在研究里很棒，在生产里则很别扭）。
@@T0@@Reach for instead:@@T1@@ deep lear.src: Reach for instead: deep learning on millions of examples (gradient descent is faster), pure point-estimation (sklearn / XGBoost), production serving (PPLs are great in research, awkward in production).

@@T0@@The deep BNN gap.@@T1@@ Bayesian n.zh: @@T0@@深度 BNN 的鸿沟。@@T1@@ 贝叶斯神经网络很难。PyMC + NUTS 在参数超过几千个后就难以为继；对贝叶斯深度模型做 VI 是有偏的。SWAG、拉普拉斯近似、深度集成与 SGLD 是实用的折中方案。
@@T0@@The deep BNN gap.@@T1@@ Bayesian n.src: The deep BNN gap. Bayesian neural nets are hard. PyMC + NUTS chokes past a few thousand parameters; VI on Bayesian-deep is biased. SWAG, Laplace, deep ensembles, and SGLD are the practical compromises.

@@T0@@Cross-link.@@T1@@ The @@T2@@Bayesi.zh: @@T0@@交叉链接。@@T1@@ @@T2@@贝叶斯后验演练场@@T3@@ 从另一个角度讲述 MCMC 与 VI；@@T4@@神经过程@@T5@@ 一文展示了摊销推断这一替代方案。
@@T0@@Cross-link.@@T1@@ The @@T2@@Bayesi.src: Cross-link. The Bayesian posterior playground covers MCMC vs VI from a different angle; the Neural Processes article shows the amortised-inference alternative.
